sourceFile: 1. BRS-161014 Report test DOE sub 2 manual_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable DOE content but the changed factor, condition grouping, and some metric interpretations are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor is a filename, not the DOE variables.
CM+CP, CM+B-PT, bonding amount, needle, and drying levels are conflated.
Some stats appear derived from headers/sample IDs, not measurements.
Tension violations against ≥80 kgf are likely missed.
correctionPlan: Define changed factor as DOE bonding amount and drying conditions at Sub 2 manual.
Preserve process subgroups CM+CP and CM+B-PT, plus date/sheet context.
Use actual data rows for each condition level, not only section/header rows.
Separate visual/decap NG outcomes from tension and bonding amount measurements.
Recalculate pass/fail using explicit specs, including tension ≥80 kgf.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are too header-heavy; final evidence needs condition and data rows.
